objective: Adapt Wan2.2-TI2V-5B to first-frame plus DROID action/proprio conditioning for 150-frame future prediction.
hypothesis: A WAN2.2-native action/proprio/history adapter with scheduled autoregressive training can improve 30-second action-following and visual consistency.
falsification_criterion: Reject if the adapter cannot bind to WAN2.2 tensor shapes, if action/frame alignment fails, or if frozen WorldArena held-out metrics do not improve without protected-metric regression.
selection_reason: DROID provides aligned wrist video, 7D action and 14D proprio; existing Wan2.1 adapters are not silently transferable.

dataset.split_policy: episode_disjoint_train_val; exclude episodes shorter than 150 frames

evaluation.heldout_protocol: episode-disjoint validation; frozen WorldArena evaluator; three seeds
